seal_status_note: This records WHICH packages sealed and at which commit. It is NOT a phase PASS: a phase passes only when its exit gate is met, and the exit gates live in the execution pack. Derived from programme/index.json — never hand-typed.

sealed_packages.invariant: every producer emits an object that validates immediately against the same canonical contract used by consumers
invalid objects fail immediately at the producer that created them
tax-rate normalisation emits one compact auditable receipt referenced by authorities
entity identity uses identifier strength and perimeter relationships
no new nullable-to-number coercion; every existing one inventoried
typed contracts proven against the corpus; legacy readable via explicit adapters

rollback: tag excel-inflow-v376-evidence-baseline; every package is an atomic commit

approvals.note: Approvals are HUMAN acts. Automation records the facts above; it does not approve a phase. Empty is the truthful state.
